posts.title: What Political Promises Are Worth
posts.description: I nearly lost a mouthful of latte over an AP story this morning. Members of Congress were outraged that President Trump had waived new sanctions on Russia. He'd done it with a waiver that Congress wrote into the law it had just passed. posts.title: Somebody Has to Design the Factory
posts.description: If you run a company that builds software, you've likely seen the demo by now. Someone types a paragraph into a box and a working application appears. It's hard to watch without doing some arithmetic on your engineering budget. posts.title: The Software I Wouldn't Have Bothered to Build
posts.description: Most engineering organizations carry a list of problems that nobody plans to fix: a release step that someone performs by hand, a script that only its author understands, a monthly report assembled by copying figures from one system into another.
